name: table21
description: Free, play-money blackjack that runs in your browser, even offline. Las Vegas, Atlantic City and European rules, a basic-strategy coach, and an installable PWA in English and Turkish. Vanilla JavaScript, no dependencies.

paragraphs: Disclaimer: Table 21 is a blackjack simulation made for entertainment and as a portfolio project. It uses play money only: there are no payments, deposits, withdrawals or prizes, and the chips have no cash value. It is not a gambling service, does not promote gambling and is not intended for any unlawful or harmful use. It is provided as is, without warranty, and the author accepts no liability for its use. Please read the full disclaimer.
A polished, fully static & offline blackjack simulation that uses play money only. No build step, no runtime dependencies, no network. Open and play.
Play Table 21 in your browser · Version 1.0.0 · GNU AGPL v3 · [](
features: Three real table profiles: Las Vegas (6 decks, H17), Atlantic City (8 decks, S17 and late surrender), and European (6 decks, S17 and no hole card). Each preset changes dealing, peek, double, surrender, and split limits…
Full action set: Hit, Stand, Double Down, Split, Surrender where permitted, Insurance, Even Money, and Rebet. Blackjack pays 3:2.

Truly random cards: a multi‑deck shoe shuffled with Fisher–Yates using crypto.getRandomValues (unbiased), reshuffled at 75% penetration or before the reserve becomes too small for a full round. Configurable 1/2/6/8…

Three saved table themes: Emerald, Midnight, and Bordeaux each pair their own woven felt with a matching card back. The walnut/brass rail, authentic A–10 pip layouts, distinct mirrored Jack/Queen/King artwork, dealing…

Physical table flow: cards leave the shoe, the hole card is exposed when the selected rules use one, and settled cards move into the discard tray. Every split hand owns an independent physical wager; doubled stakes…
